verdict_rationale: One HIGH finding (F-1): the PBO NOT_RUN survivor-label chain is internally contradictory across §6/§10/§11 — §6 makes the NOT_RUN label a bookability precondition carried into the terminal outcome name AND the §10 result language, but §11's frozen survivor token 'STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY' and §10's mandated verbatim disclosure string cannot carry it. A literal T-close yields a bookable survivor record missing a mandatory fail-closed NOT_RUN disclosure — conclusion-changing per the mission invariant that missing evidence is NOT_RUN and must be labelled. Per the packet rule, any HIGH forces REFUSED. The remaining findings (2 MEDIUM, 4 LOW) are byte-fixable and do not independently block.

findings.quote_bytes: §6 lines 396-399: 'a survivor with PBO NOT_RUN is bookable ONLY with the NOT_RUN label carried into the terminal outcome name and the §10 result language'; §11 lines 479-481: 'STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY (only if Stage-A passes; carries the §3 disclosure; never a profitability claim)'; §10 lines 467-469: 'Any result language must carry the §3 relaxation disclosure verbatim: "accepted under owner-relaxed acceptance battery (R0 0.30 / DSR alpha 0.10 at N = grid)"'.
findings.why_wrong: §6 imposes a bookability precondition: the PBO NOT_RUN label must be carried into (a) the terminal outcome name and (b) the §10 result language. The §11 prewritten survivor token is frozen without any PBO_NOT_RUN marker and its parenthetical enumerates only the §3 disclosure; §10's mandated verbatim string likewise contains no PBO NOT_RUN clause. Three sections of the same frozen plan disagree on the mandatory content of the only positive terminal outcome. A terminal close that honors §11's exact token and §10's verbatim string satisfies their letter while omitting the §6-mandated label, producing a bookable-survivor record in which the fail-closed PBO NOT_RUN evidence state is unlabeled. This is a conclusion-changing disclosure defect in the exact space (NOT_RUN honesty) the program treats as a mission invariant, and it fits the audit-item-6 class 'anything the latest remediation newly broke': the §6 PBO paragraph reads as remediation text whose label requirement was never propagated into the §10/§11 language.
findings.required_remediation: Strengthen in the fail-closed direction: amend the §11 token to carry the label (e.g. STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY_PBO_NOT_RUN) and extend §10's mandated disclosure string to include the PBO NOT_RUN clause (e.g. '; PBO NOT_RUN (fail-closed, <8 configurations)'), so §6's precondition is satisfiable verbatim by any compliant close.

findings.quote_bytes: §5 lines 263-265: 'each family's C-COMPLEMENT and component-only (R4) book definitions'; §6 R5 lines 366-372: 'R5 component placebo: the family's component-only book (declared per family in the D1 manifest: ...)'
findings.why_wrong: The D1 manifest's fail-closed required-fields list attributes the component-only book definitions to R4, but in the frozen §6 numbering R4 is the C-REVERSAL-PLAIN reversal reduction (a single global control book, not per-family) and R5 is the component placebo that consumes the per-family component-only books. The label is a wrong cross-reference (should be R5). Damage is contained because §6 R5 independently mandates the same per-family declaration in the D1 manifest, so the battery cannot silently lose R5; but a checklist validator honoring §5's letter demands an incoherent artifact ('per-family R4 definitions'), and the two authorities disagree inside a fail-closed freeze contract.
findings.required_remediation: Change '(R4)' to '(R5)' in the §5 required-fields list (and consider citing both R3's C-COMPLEMENT and R5's component-only books explicitly).

findings.quote_bytes: §5 lines 209-210: 'realized-vol tercile-conditional drift, lookback {21, 63}, H in {5, 20}'; lines 216-217: 'long in the construction-favoured tercile, flat otherwise (long-only law)'
findings.why_wrong: The tercile ESTIMATOR is pinned (close-to-close log-return std ddof=1; 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles, linear interpolation, trailing 252-session window, causal, refreshed daily) but the SIGN-bearing parameter — WHICH tercile is 'construction-favoured' — is neither named nor given a construction derivation, unlike every other family's sign/direction treatment. This also contradicts the plan's own enumeration rule (§5 lines 266-269: 'where construction logic admits both directions they are enumerated as distinct configurations inside the cap'), which GAP and DVOL-SHOCK honor by enumerating fade AND confirm as distinct configurations; VOL-REGIME instead freezes a single unspecified 'favoured' tercile. The residual degree of freedom (long-low-vol vs long-high-vol) is outcome-adjacent: it is exactly the axis R1 adjudicates, and leaving it as an unnamed ex-ante label risks a literature-prior sign choice entering without disclosure. Mitigations that keep this below HIGH: the sign must be pinned in the hashed D1 manifest before any measurement ('each configuration's sign as frozen from construction logic', lines 266-268), and R1 + Stage-A still bind on whichever sign is frozen.
findings.required_remediation: Pin the favoured tercile per lookback (low/mid/high) with its construction-logic derivation in the plan, or enumerate both tercile-directions as distinct configurations inside the cap, symmetric with GAP/DVOL-SHOCK.

findings.quote_bytes: §3 lines 105-111: 'NOT relaxed (mission invariant, non-negotiable): ... the full R2/R3/R4/R5/R6 control-out-earn and reduction rules ... drop-one stability, the PBO NOT_RUN-fail-closed disposition (§6), concentration <= 50%, MDD <= 15%, SPY-excess fold rule ...'
findings.why_wrong: The §3 not-relaxed enumeration omits K6 (slow-drift combination) and the Stage-A fold-positive-share > 50% kill (and the PIT-mutation control and long-only law). Because §3 frames the grant as relaxing EXACTLY the four tabulated axes, these omissions are cosmetic — K6 and fold-positive-share stand unchanged regardless — but the list is presented as the battery-complete non-negotiables and is not.
findings.required_remediation: Add K6 and the fold-positive-share gate (and PIT mutation) to the §3 not-relaxed enumeration.

findings.quote_bytes: §6 lines 313-315: 'event-conditional 5d/21d return and drawdown-depth short-term-reversal states (BINDING — sparse books understate in cohort-wide rho)'; §5 lines 233-237: 'ADDITIONALLY, for any family whose fired-day share is below 30%, a fired-day-conditioned rho against the shadow's fired-day returns is computed'
findings.why_wrong: The R0 inventory tags the event-conditional reversal states BINDING, while §5's operational convention consumes the fired-day-conditioned form only for families whose fired-day share is below 30%. A family sitting at or above 30% fired-day share faces cohort-wide rho only against states whose own annotation says cohort-wide rho understates sparse books. The convention is fail-closed in direction (max of the two |rho| where triggered) and frozen pre-measurement, so this is a tension, not a hole, but the 30% boundary and the BINDING tag are not reconciled.
findings.required_remediation: State in §5 that for shadows tagged BINDING the fired-day-conditioned rho is computed and consumed for ALL families (or justify the 30% threshold against the BINDING annotation).

findings.section: §5 required fields (lines 261-272) and §4 F9 (lines 163-168) vs §6 R0 (lines 311-328)
findings.quote_bytes: §6 lines 311-313: 'R0 shadow inventory (ENUMERATED, hashed and committed BEFORE any rho; under-enumerated inventory = invalid PASS, fail-closed)'; §5 required-fields list lines 261-272 does not name it
findings.why_wrong: The hashed R0 shadow inventory — the artifact the veto consumes — is not among the D1 manifest's fail-closed required fields, and its artifact home is not pinned (F9 pins 'the frozen search-space manifest' only). Missing shadows fail loudly (no rho computable; under-enumeration = invalid PASS), so this cannot pass silently, but the freeze contract should name where the hashed inventory and the S0 measurement-window extent live. Related minor unpins folded here: the GAP percentile interpolation method and the S0 window definition are not stated in-plan.
findings.required_remediation: Add to the §5 required-fields list (or F9): the hashed R0 shadow inventory with its ancestry-grep basis, the S0 window boundaries, and the percentile interpolation convention.
